name: Reeve
archiveRole: Is a patient keeper of lists who cannot leave an ask stranded. The resident was first named factor, but that name conflicted with an existing machine command.
storyFunction: The village's blocker-ledger keeper, following every unresolved ask until it reaches the person or mechanism that can clear it.
lockedDesign: Canonical Nosis black cat proportions and face
Fitted warm-russet waistcoat with charcoal edging, four neatly aligned tabbed pockets with muted teal tabs and brass studs, and restrained brass front buttons
Cream shirt with sleeves rolled once, slim charcoal tie, charcoal high-waisted trousers, and an upright patient posture
No robot anatomy, exposed machinery, cables, screens, railway scenery, floating question marks, hat, bag, armor, extra tools, or extra accessories
roleProp: One long closed warm-russet pending-asks ledger with a charcoal spine, cream page block, visible muted teal page tabs, and brass corner protectors
